title: Design Rationale as Evidence
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting design rationale as evidence to the design-rationale log entry with claim, evidence, warrant, rejected alternatives, and planned check, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Distinguish a description of a design (what it contains) from a rationale (why, with alternatives weighed)
Structure a rationale entry as claim, evidence, warrant, and rejected alternatives
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to decide what help or design change should come next

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
